venture.name: Thinking Machines Lab
venture.team: About 100 people (2026); two co-founders returned to OpenAI in January 2026.
venture.current_state: Tinker (fine-tuning API) launched October 2025, GA December 2025; Inkling (975B open weights, Apache) and Inkling Small released July 2026. Self-reported revenue run rate above $100M (unaudited). One gigawatt of NVIDIA compute agreed March 2026. A public benefit corporation where the founder holds a weighted deciding vote.
sources: AI Magazine on Tinker run rate

core.source: Our reading of its launch statements and products; no filing exists.
core.promise: Researchers and builders can shape frontier-class models to their own needs: open weights, with the hard training infrastructure done for them.
core.promised_to: Researchers, developers and companies that need customised models.
core.must_not: Open models under its name that enable serious misuse, or customisation that quietly locks customers in.
core.competence: Post-training and fine-tuning research (reinforcement learning, efficient adapters) and the infrastructure to run it for others.

tinker.name: Tinker
tinker.description: API for fine-tuning open models with your own training loop; the lab runs the clusters.

collab.name: Human-AI collaboration product
collab.description: The multimodal, collaborative AI product the lab has said it will build; not shipped.
